newsitem.title: USA: Colorado cattle trading very slow - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Colorado cattle trading very slow - USDA.

text.p: Trading of slaughter cattle very slow Wednesday.
Slaughter steers and heifers not established. Week to date total includes 7,200 head sold on a contract or formula basis for this weeks' delivery. Sales reported on 150 steers and 150 heifers.
Slaughter steers: Carcass basis: Select and Choice 2-3
Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050 lbs 70.00.
Confirmed Sales: 300 Last Week: 50 Last Year: 200
Week to Date : 17,600 Last Week: 25,800 Last year: 15,800
